SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: Single HTTP GET through app.Fetcher with robots.txt check; the sale page contains JSON-LD ItemList and __NEXT_DATA__ Apollo state. No pagination, product-page crawl, sign-in or checkout.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: 18 LEGO sale sets parsed; 18 with current and list reference; 18 normalized rows in a local catalog test.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: Set number/productCode plus variant SKU and product URL; no variant range collapsed into a different set.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: Single sale page; listPrice is LEGO's reference, not a historical paid price; rights review remains open.

PAGING_RECEIPT.strategy: Single sales-and-deals page; no page parameter followed.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: ProductVariant.listPrice only when greater than current; otherwise null.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Missing current price or product path is skipped; listPrice at or below current is not treated as a reference.

IDENTITY_RECEIPT.note: LEGO set number is the exact set identity; variant SKU is retained separately. No cross-set consolidation.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: Single local read-only capture; LEGO terms, retention and redistribution rights remain unresolved.

CATALOG_RECEIPT.local_test: 18 LEGO rows merged into a temporary catalog with source LEGO.

TEST_RECEIPT.fixture: Synthetic __NEXT_DATA__ Apollo state with two sets, plus one local real capture.
TEST_RECEIPT.live_capture: One local public-page capture; not an authorized live acceptance.
